title: 第一卷 第88章 猎杀时刻第一卷 第87章 寻妖
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: “这应当就是‘青玉蟒’蜕下的鳞。”
林寻掂量着，脑海中浮现出有关信息。
青玉蟒，上品血脉，妖核品质纯净。
属性以水土为主，较为平稳中和，只要到达二阶，就适合替代玄灵果。
“终于是有眉目了！应该就在这附近。”
林寻欣喜过后，施展追踪之术，配合地岩鼠，在峡谷内寻找。
两个时辰后。
藤蔓覆盖的山壁间，一个隐蔽洞口被地岩鼠率先发现。
地岩鼠目露忌惮，在洞口徘徊，不敢靠近。
蛇蟒，天生对于鼠类有克制。
林寻反而心中一喜，能让地岩鼠如此紧张惶恐的，里面起码是一条二阶青玉蟒。
“最好是二阶初期。”
林寻低喃道，心中有些期许。
如果是二阶中期，他就得权衡利弊，若是二阶后期，他二话不说，扭头就跑。
不过看之前的蜕皮，不像是中后期，待见到后，才能知晓。
林寻找到了地方，索性也不急切。
他猎来两头一阶妖兽摆放洞口，就快速退去，等着里面的动静。
只是区区一个时辰，一条长约五六丈，通体青岩的巨蟒走出山洞，将食物卷走。
“运气不错！”
林寻见到这体型心中大定，这条青玉蟒，似乎刚突破二阶不久，体型不算大，急缺进补的食物。
没想到，第一次找到的特殊二阶妖兽就这么合适，不得不说也是有气运在的。
他看向地上不愿动弹的地岩鼠，没好气的踹了一脚，
“怎么？区区蟒蛇就怕了？这次可就靠你将青玉蟒引进阵。”
地岩鼠又是缩了缩，眼中流露出恐惧和委屈。
林寻捏着老鼠耳朵，“这些年，我为了养你，不知道花费了多少灵石，况且又不是真让你去送死！”
虽然地岩鼠不明白什么意思，但爪子依然不安的颤抖。
它本来就是老鼠，也只有一阶巅峰，现在要去勾引二阶妖兽，也太难了。
“放心去吧！”
林寻再次宽慰一声，若是地岩鼠仍不同意，那就只能用御兽牌强制行动了。
再次贴两张精品防御符在黄皮耗子的身上，将它推了出去。
希望关键的时候能保命。
在毗邻洞口的一处小山谷中，传来一阵嘶嘶的刺耳蛇信声，片刻后青玉蟒出现。
当见到两头低阶妖兽的尸体，这只虚弱的青玉蟒也顾不上考虑其他，上前开始吞食起来。
而远处隐匿的林寻看到后，不由深吸一口气。
蕴息术运转到极致，贴上上品隐匿符，本就做的谨慎。
外加这只二阶妖兽刚突破虚弱，自然发现不了他。
吱！
一声颤抖的鼠叫声回荡下，青玉蟒瞬间抬头，露出了蛇类独有的竖瞳。

"This should be the scales shed by the 'Jade Python'."
Lin Xun weighed it, and relevant information emerged in his mind.
Sapphire python, top-grade bloodline, pure quality demon core.
Its attributes are mainly water and earth, which is relatively stable and neutral. As long as it reaches the second level, it is suitable to replace the Xuanling Fruit.
"Finally we have an idea! It should be around here."
After Lin Xun was overjoyed, he used the tracking technique and cooperated with the rock rat to search in the canyon.
...
Two hours later.
Between the vine-covered mountain walls, a hidden cave entrance was first discovered by the rock rat.
The rock rat looked fearful and lingered at the entrance of the cave, not daring to get close.
Snakes and pythons are naturally restrained towards rats.
Lin Xun was overjoyed. What could make the Earth Rock Rat so nervous and frightened was at least a second-order jade python inside.
"It's best to be at the early stage of the second level."
Lin Xun murmured, with some expectations in his heart.
If it was the middle stage of the second stage, he would have to weigh the pros and cons. If it was the late stage of the second stage, he would turn around and run away without saying a word.
However, looking at the previous shedding, it doesn’t look like the middle and late stages. You can only know it after seeing it.
Lin found the place and was not in a hurry.
He hunted two first-level monsters and placed them at the entrance of the cave, then quickly retreated, waiting for any movement inside.
In just an hour, a giant python about five or six feet long, with a body made of blue rocks, came out of the cave and swept away the food.
"Good luck!"
Lin Xun felt reassured when he saw this size. This jade python seemed to have just broken through the second level. It was not very big and was in urgent need of nourishing food.
Unexpectedly, the special second-level monster that I found for the first time was so suitable. I have to say that it was also a matter of luck.
He looked at the ground rock rat that was unwilling to move, and kicked him angrily.
"What? Are you afraid of a mere python? This time it's up to you to introduce the jade python into the formation."
The rock rat shrank again, fear and grievance showing in its eyes.
Lin Xun pinched the mouse's ears and said, "I have spent countless spiritual stones on raising you over the years, and besides, I didn't really ask you to die!"
Although the rock rat didn't understand what it meant, its paws still trembled uneasily.
It was originally a mouse and only had the first level peak. Now it was too difficult to seduce the second level monster.
"Go without worry!"
Lin Xun once again expressed relief. If the rock rat still disagreed, he could only use the beast control card to force action.
Paste two high-quality defense talismans on the yellow-skinned mouse again and push it out.
I hope I can save my life at the critical moment.
...
In a small valley adjacent to the cave entrance, there was a hissing and harsh snake sound, and a moment later the jade python appeared.
When it saw the corpses of two low-level monsters, the weak jade python stepped forward and started to devour them without thinking about anything else.
Lin Xun, who was hiding in the distance, couldn't help but take a deep breath after seeing it.
The aura technique was operating to the extreme, and the top-grade concealment talisman was affixed, which was done cautiously.
In addition, this second-level monster had just broken through its weakness, so naturally it couldn't find him.
squeak!
A trembling rat cry echoed, and the jade python instantly raised its head, revealing its unique vertical pupils of snakes.
